description: End-to-end B2B SD-WAN service design, ordering, provisioning, and lifecycle management workflow

site_id.description: Unique identifier for a customer site/location

service_order_id.description: Identifier for an SD-WAN service order

service_id.description: Identifier for a provisioned SD-WAN service instance

design_id.description: Identifier for an SD-WAN high-level design

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a service change request

workflow_run_id.description: Identifier for an orchestration workflow execution

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: list_account_sites
functions.description: List and filter sites for a given enterprise account to be used in SD-WAN design and ordering

filters.description: Optional filters for narrowing down sites

has_existing_wan.description: Filter sites that already have some WAN connection

functions.returns: List of sites for the account with pagination metadata

functions.name: check_site_connectivity_options
functions.description: Check available access and underlay options for an SD-WAN site, including bandwidth tiers and redundancy options

account_id.description: Owning account, used for contract-level constraints

flexibility_days.description: Tolerance around requested RFS date in days

functions.returns: Available connectivity options including access types, bandwidth tiers, lead times, and feasibility flags

functions.name: design_sd_wan_solution
functions.description: Create a high-level SD-WAN design across multiple sites including topology, policies, and underlay choices

account_id.description: Customer account for which the SD-WAN is designed

sites.description: Sites to be included in the SD-WAN solution and their role

qos_profile.description: Reference to a QoS template or profile name

security_policy.description: High-level security and firewall policy requirements

sla_profile.description: Requested SLA tier identifier, e.g., GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE

functions.returns: Design ID and a summary of the proposed SD-WAN solution including estimated recurring and one-time charges

functions.name: validate_design_feasibility
functions.description: Validate an SD-WAN design against network feasibility, policy rules, and commercial constraints

design_id.description: Identifier of the SD-WAN design to validate

override_policies.description: Optional override flags for internal use when validating

what_if_changes.description: Optional transient modifications to design parameters for simulation only

path.description: JSON pointer or dot path to field to change

proposed_value.description: Value to temporarily apply for what-if analysis

functions.returns: Feasibility verdict, list of issues/warnings, and recommended corrections for the design

functions.name: create_sd_wan_service_order
functions.description: Create an SD-WAN service order based on an approved design, including commercial terms and requested start date

requested_rfs_date.description: Requested ready-for-service date for the SD-WAN

contacts.description: Commercial and technical contacts for the order

order_notes.description: Additional notes or instructions for order processing

functions.returns: Service order ID and initial order status with a high-level milestone plan

functions.name: get_service_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve details and current status of an SD-WAN service order including per-site milestones
functions.returns: Full service order details including overall and per-site status, milestones, and any exceptions

functions.name: trigger_provisioning_workflow
functions.description: Start or resume orchestration workflow to provision SD-WAN services for an order or a subset of sites

site_ids.description: When provisioning only part of the order

target.description: Email address, URL, or ticket queue

functions.returns: Workflow run ID, initial workflow state, and a summary of planned provisioning tasks

functions.name: get_provisioning_workflow_status
functions.description: Get real-time status and task-level details of a provisioning workflow run

include.description: Additional elements to include in response

functions.returns: Overall workflow status, optional list of tasks with statuses, and any blocking issues or rollback details

functions.name: retry_failed_provisioning_steps
functions.description: Retry failed tasks within a provisioning workflow run, with optional remediation instructions

workflow_run_id.description: Workflow run where tasks have failed

retry_scope.description: Scope and behavior of the retry operation

task_ids.description: Specific task IDs to retry when mode=by_task_ids

site_ids.description: Sites whose failed tasks should be retried when mode=by_site_ids

remediation_instructions.description: Optional remediation data to adjust behavior in retries

parameters_patch.description: Partial override of task input parameters

functions.returns: Updated workflow run status and list of tasks scheduled for retry

functions.name: rollback_sd_wan_provisioning
functions.description: Rollback a partially or fully provisioned SD-WAN service to the last known good state or to a clean state

workflow_run_id.description: The workflow run to rollback from (optional if rolling back by service)

service_id.description: SD-WAN service instance to rollback (optional if rolling back by workflow)

scope.description: Defines how broad the rollback should be

target_state.description: Logical point in time to rollback to

reason.description: Reason for rollback, e.g., customer cancellation, design defect

customer_visible.description: Whether rollback should be annotated in customer-facing portals

functions.returns: Rollback job identifier, status, and a description of the changes that will be or were reverted

functions.name: modify_sd_wan_service
functions.description: Submit a change request to modify an active SD-WAN service, including bandwidth upgrades, policy changes, or site adds/removes

service_id.description: Active SD-WAN service instance to modify

requested_effective_date.description: When the change should be applied

change_details.description: Polymorphic object containing details specific to the change_type

approval_reference.description: External approval or CAB reference ID

customer_impact_window.description: Planned maintenance window for the change

functions.returns: Change request ID, preliminary impact assessment, and next steps for implementation

functions.name: cancel_sd_wan_order_or_change
functions.description: Cancel a pending SD-WAN service order or change request with appropriate validations and impact assessment

service_order_id.description: Order to cancel if cancelling an order

change_request_id.description: Change request to cancel if cancelling a change

force_cancel.description: If true, attempt cancellation even if in advanced stage, may incur penalties

notify_contacts.description: Whether to notify customer contacts on cancellation

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation including final status, any applicable penalties, and notifications dispatched

functions.name: get_sd_wan_service_inventory
functions.description: Retrieve current SD-WAN service inventory for an account, including services, sites, and configuration summaries

account_id.description: Account whose SD-WAN inventory should be listed

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow down inventory

include_details.description: Additional details to include for each service

functions.returns: Paginated list of SD-WAN services and associated sites with optional configuration summaries

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import sd wan fulfillment entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many sd wan fulfillment entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many sd wan fulfillment entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_bulk_export
functions.description: Export sd wan fulfillment entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across sd wan fulfillment entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for sd wan fulfillment events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for sd wan fulfillment notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more sd wan fulfillment entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to sd wan fulfillment on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a sd wan fulfillment operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending sd wan fulfillment change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending sd wan fulfillment approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a sd wan fulfillment entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a sd wan fulfillment entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a sd wan fulfillment entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sd wan fulfillment entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for sd wan fulfillment activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a sd wan fulfillment view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to sd wan fulfillment entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given sd wan fulfillment payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a sd wan fulfillment entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: sd_wan_fulfillment_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a sd wan fulfillment entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
